releaseNotes: Smart Search Index is now managed from Settings with exact Indexed X of Y progress, Ready/Indexing/Paused status, last-updated time, Resume Indexing and a confirmed Rebuild Index action. Completed Image/PDF file versions are persisted in the local index, so interrupted indexing resumes from the files still pending instead of starting over. Find now searches the saved index immediately and no longer owns or waits for the OCR indexing process. Existing document-image filtering, Screenshot/scan/PDF priority, voice search and opening motion are preserved.
